blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — 1PWD party-list Rep. JD Castro said that his group will file a complaint before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) against Machong Chismisan podcast hosts over their insensitive remarks directed towards people with disabilities (PWD). The five male hosts faced backlash after they made comments about Joshua “Josh” Aquino, the eldest son of television host Kris Aquino, who is on the autism spectrum, in one of their podcast episodes. The episode has been taken down from the podcast’s page. READ: Podcast hosts mock Kris Aquino’s son Josh “Hindi po biro ang disability. Hindi po ito punchline. At higit […]...
